Global context.XMLString

Global context

XMLString

Available since version 8.0.

Syntax:

XMLString(<Value>)

Parameters:

<Value> (required)

Type: Undefined, Null, Boolean, Number, String, Date, UUID, BinaryData, ValueStorage.
Value to be converted to a string representation, which can be used as an item text or an XML attribute value.

Returned value:

Type: String.

Description:

Obtains the XML representation of the value to be inserted into the item text, or the XML attribute value.

Availability:

Thin client, mobile client, server, thick client, external connection, mobile application (client), mobile application (server), mobile standalone server.

Example:

XMLWriter = New XMLWriter;
XMLWriter.WriteText(XMLString(MaturityDate));

See also:

Global context, method XMLValue

Available since:

Available since version 8.0.
